  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams , including Product Marketing, Product Development, Consulting, Growth, Onboarding, and Customer Success, to bridge gaps, inform future strategies, and ensure seamless customer journeys.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of the Sales Engineer playbook , sharing best practices and insights for the LATAM market.
  • Represent Netcore at industry events, conferences, and meetups across the LATAM region, building brand awareness and thought leadership.


What We Look For:


  • Strong ownership mentality , demonstrating discipline, focus, and unwavering commitment to customer success.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and proven ability to navigate and overcome objections effectively.
  • Adept at creating impactful and innovative demonstrations that resonate with clients and clearly articulate value, leveraging available content and tools.
  • Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in sales engineering or pre-sales within the MarTech industry .
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills in both technical and business contexts, with fluency in Portuguese and English being essential. Spanish language proficiency is highly desirable.
  • This role is based in Brazil and requires flexibility to travel across the LATAM region for in-person meetings with key accounts.
  • A genuine passion for continuous learning , staying abreast of new MarTech tools and evolving market trends within Latin America.
  • Proven ability to support clients with complex MarTech needs , demonstrating a deep understanding of marketing automation, personalization, and customer engagement strategies.
  • Capacity to effectively support multiple Sales Leaders operating within the LATAM markets.
  • Deep expertise in the MarTech landscape and a strong understanding of SaaS solutions.
  • Proven ability to craft impactful product demos that clearly showcase value to clients.
  • Experience in contributing to or developing sales engineering playbooks and best practices.
  • This role will report to the Regional Lead of Product Sales and Growth.


Why Netcore?


Netcore Cloud is a leading AI/ML-powered personalization full-stack MarTech platform empowering B2C brands to elevate customer engagement, drive conversions, boost revenue, and enhance retention throughout the entire customer lifecycle.


We proudly partner with over 8500+ enterprise brands across 18 countries and serve more than 70% of India's Unicorns, establishing us as a top-tier personalization marketing platform.


Headquartered in India, our global presence extends across 18 countries. Netcore has been recognized as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years, underscoring our people-first culture rooted in the values of honesty, humanity, openness, and a deep commitment to the success of both our customers and employees.


Embarking on a career at Netcore transcends a typical job – it's an opportunity to shape the future of MarTech. For further information, we invite you to visit netcorecloud.Com or connect with us on LinkedIn.


Your Success:


  • Experience significant growth through experimentation on product-market fit within the LATAM region, collaborating closely with all functions to drive success in specific customer segments and verticals.
  • Enjoy the opportunity to explore your entrepreneurial mindset within a supportive and innovative environment.

title: Gerente De Secops
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Gerente de SecOps



Resumo:

O Gerente de SecOps é responsável pela estratégia e entrega do dia a dia de Security Operations através da companhia, incluindo SOC (Security Operations Center), Gestão de Vulnerabilidades, Pentesting e Gestão de Identidades. Esta posição, com reporte ao Diretor de Cyber Security, desempenhará um papel fundamental no fortalecimento da postura de segurança da empresa, liderando uma equipe de profissionais de segurança e garantindo que o ambiente seja continuamente monitorado e protegido.



O que você irá fazer:

  • Estratégia de SecOps: liderar a estratégia de Security Operations do ponto de vista de pessoas, processos e ferramentas, desenhando modelos de operação técnica e documentações, gerenciando ferramentas de segurança e KPIs de processos, orçamento e riscos com recursos internos e externos.
  • Liderança do SOC: liderar e supervisionar as operações 24/7 do SOC, incluindo monitoramento, detecção, resposta a incidentes e inteligência de ameaças.
  • Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: liderar o programa de gestão de vulnerabilidades da empresa, garantindo a identificação, relatório, priorização e remediação de riscos de forma eficaz para ativos de infraestrutura e código seguro.
  • Pentesting: liderar atividades e exercícios de pentest/red team internos e externos com aplicações de negócios e infraestrutura.
  • Gestão de Identidade e Acesso: liderar o programa de IAM incluindo governança, provisionamento, gerenciamento de acesso privilegiado e controles de acesso baseados em funções.
  • Gestão de Pessoas: gerenciar, orientar e desenvolver uma equipe de coordenadores, engenheiros e analistas de segurança.




O que buscamos?

  • Sólida experiência em operações de cibersegurança e em funções de gestão ou liderança.
  • Excelente conhecimento e experiência prática com implementação, implantação e operações de ferramentas de segurança, incluindo SIEM/SOAR (por exemplo, Sentinel, Chronicle, Splunk), EDR/XDR (Crowdstrike, Defender, SentinelOne, etc.), scan de vulnerabilidades (Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, etc.), SAST/DAST/SCA (Checkmarx, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk), frameworks de pentesting e red team (Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, Caldera, etc.) e IAM (Azure AD, Okta, CyberArk, etc.).
  • Sólida compreensão de segurança em nuvem (Azure, GCP, AWS).
  • Ótimo conhecimento de frameworks de segurança (MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, etc.).
  • Ótimas habilidades analíticas e de relatórios para apoiar a entrega de KPIs.
  • Experiência em gerenciar múltiplos fornecedores e entrega de serviços globais.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão.
  • Forte conhecimento prático das ferramentas do Office.
  • Fluente em inglês.



Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações de segurança como CISSP, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001, ITILv3+ ou similares.
  • Espanhol será um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:




  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido

  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
    Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua




Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!




Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Especialista Em Automação E Software

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

  • Realizar projetos elétricos em plantas de energias renováveis (biogás).

  • Controlar interfaces e funcionamento de todos os módulos.
  • Realizar Interligações e controle de funcionamento em diferentes sistemas de comunicações, como: Profinet, Profibus, PA, As-Interface e outros.
  • Auxiliar o Gerente de Projeto na aprovação dos equipamentos nos fornecedores, bem como no sistema completo de purificação de biogás na planta do cliente.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.G., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.

Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.

Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.

Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.

Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.

Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.

Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

Ingredientes que Buscamos

  • Experiência em vendas: Um diferencial será ter atuado com vendas externas, prospecção ou gestão de carteira.
  • Comunicação excepcional: Habilidade oral e escrita para interações via telefone, WhatsApp e e-mail.
  • Perfil organizado e resiliente: Energia, senso de dono e capacidade de se adaptar a um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Habilidade de negociação e persuasão: Capacidade de argumentar e buscar resultados acima da média, sempre com foco no cliente.
  • Relacionamento interpessoal: Facilidade em criar conexões significativas e construir parcerias de longo prazo.
  • Morar na cidade e ter como se locomover: Ser residente da cidade de São Lourenço - MG ou das cidades de Itatiaia - RJ ou Cachoeira Paulista - SP e possuir mobilidade para realizar deslocamentos com facilidade.


Sobre Nós

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Senior Strategy Research Associate
description:
About Keeta


Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. With over 1,000 team members around the world , Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!



Know more: Keeta Website


About the Job


Senior Strategy Research Associate


Location: 100% On site - Vila Olimpia, SP


Job Responsibilities：


1. Study the business segments, geographical layout, financial strength, and strategic play of the world's leading food delivery players, form a clear judgment on the global food delivery industry landscape and competitive situation, and propose effective development strategies and competitive strategies based on this judgment to support Keeta management's major decisions on resource allocation, organizational structure, capital operation, etc.


2. Participate in desk research, field research, and strategy formulation for Keeta's expansion into new countries, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation path of the company's strategic expansion into new regions, and combine facts and analysis to provide objective judgments on the industry, competition, and operational difficulties in specific countries to assist Keeta management in making decisions;


3. Understand the catering and food delivery industries, gain insight into the laws of industry development, keep close track of new opportunities and new models in related areas such as instant retail and catering SaaS, explore and evaluate the feasibility and implementation paths of new strategic directions to assist Keeta management in making decisions and assist in business implementation. Job Responsibilities:


4. Analyze the restaurant and food delivery industries, identify industry trends, and monitor emerging opportunities in related sectors such as quick commerce and restaurant SaaS. Explore and evaluate the feasibility of new strategic directions to support management in decision-making and business implementation.


Job Requirements：

  • Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in business-related majors such as business administration, finance, accounting, and economics;
  • At least threeyears of relevant experience in internet strategy analysis, strategic consulting, investment, and investment banking, with research experience in the catering, retail, and food delivery industries preferred;
  • Possess a keenbusiness acumen, structured thinking skills, excellent oral and written communication skills, self-motivation and independent thinking, strong data analysis skills, and extensive project management and teamwork experience;
  • Working level English proficiency (C2).


Highlights：


- Contribute to the foundational growth of the Brazil business from inception.

- Join a core team within a key business unit, gaining a comprehensive understanding of the food delivery industry and enhancing commercial analysis capabilities.

- Work closely with senior decision-makers as part of a high-performing team.


Please upload both your English resume, thanks!

Sobre a ZEISS


Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.


Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

title: Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About the Role:

We seek a highly skilled Azure Cloud Architect to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing cloud-based solutions on Microsoft Azure. You will be responsible for architecting scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure to support our business applications and services.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure cloud solutions to meet business requirements.

  • Ensure compliance with security policies and industry regulations.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud infrastructure and services.
  • Stay updated with the latest Azure services, features, and best practices.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and Azure architecture.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as ARM templates, Microsoft Bicep, Azure Resource Manager, and Terraform.
  • Knowledge of networking, TCP/IP basics, security, and identity management in Azure.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Azure certifications (e.G., Azure Solutions Architect Expert-AZ 305, ) are a plus.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with other cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud).
  • Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools like Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.

title: Mobility Operations & Immigration Management
description:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.


Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.



Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Pré-requisitos:

Nosso compromisso com a Diversidade e Inclusão

A ZEISS acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas em nossos processos seletivos. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de oportunidades. Valorizamos e respeitamos todas as diferenças.

title: Estagiário De Finanças
description:
A falta de tempo sempre foi considerada inimiga da alimentação saudável. Quem nunca precisou recorrer a “fast-food pesadão” por dispor de apenas alguns minutos para almoçar?

Para nós 10 minutos é tempo de sobra para você preparar ou receber refeições deliciosas e saudáveis!

Após duas décadas no ramo de alimentação, hoje atuamos com a Cumbuca Boa e a Piadina Romagnola.

A Cumbuca Boa é um e-commerce que oferece comida ultracongelada, saudável e deliciosa. Que nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade e quebrar de vez o tabu da comida congelada, acredite se quiser… Ou melhor, experimente e dê sua opinião!

A empresa tem como propósito revitalizar a imagem da comida instantânea, proporcionando refeições ultra-rápidas e com a qualidade de comida feita em casa. Nosso crescimento e os constantes elogios comprovam que nossos clientes estão de acordo.

A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 14 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.



Gostamos de proporcionar o bem aos outros, seja através da nossa comida, seja através da nossa forma de trabalhar.

Descrição da Vaga

Encontrar uma empresa jovem, com um ambiente aberto, dinâmico e sempre orientado à satisfação de nossos clientes. Estamos em uma fase de crescimento acelerado nas duas empresas, o que prova que estamos no caminho certo! Fazer parte dessa fase significa vivenciar algo único: uma empresa que hoje é pequena, mas que amanhã pode ter o tamanho dos sonhos das pessoas que dela fazem parte.

Para sonhar com o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência ou deseje aprender sobre área de Operações. Alguém que tenha conhecimento, pró atividade e discernimento para, com o passar do tempo, prever e antecipar demandas e próximos passos.

Objetivo

O objetivo é oferecer suporte analítico á diretoria da empresa. Com análises, estudos e acompanhamento de projetos.

Nessa posição

Precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha talento com números. Você será o responsável por dar suporte ao time financeiro, tendo como principais atribuições:



Contas a Pagar e Receber: Auxiliar nos lançamentos de contas a pagar, acompanhar processos de aprovação de despesas, registrar informações no sistema ERP e realizar efetivações bancárias.


Faturamento/Contas a Receber: Apoiar na conciliação do fluxo de recebimentos, gerar cobranças via links de pagamento e emitir NF-e pelo sistema ERP.


Apoio à Contabilidade: Enviar informações à contabilidade, garantindo que os lançamentos sejam corretamente documentados e escriturados.


Elaboração de Relatórios: Colaborar na preparação de relatórios gerenciais, fornecendo dados que apoiem a tomada de decisão do time financeiro.



Requisitos Técnicos:



Estar cursando graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Financeira, Economia ou áreas correlatas;


Ter disponibilidade de trabalhar presencialmente de seg a sex das 9:00 às 16:00


Interesse em conhecer e atuar nos setores de tesouraria e planejamento financeiro;


Proatividade, organização, atenção aos detalhes, boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;


Capacidade analítica e raciocínio lógico;


Conhecimento do pacote Office, especialmente Excel.



O Processo



O nosso processo seletivo começa na inscrição. Se você está a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, capriche nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno mesmo para quem não segue no processo.



Sobre o nosso processo seletivo:



Geralmente leva em torno de 30 dias (desde a aplicação até o fim do processo) e contém as seguintes etapas:

Inscrição/triagem;

Entrevista com o time de RH;

Entrevistas com gestor área;

Oferta.


Como se trata de uma empresa jovem, pensamos numa posição majoritariamente presencial. Estamos localizados no Bairro Vila Cordeiro, São Paulo, 10 minutos da estação de metro Brooklin.


Bolsa Auxílio R$2,2 mil

Vale-transporte;

Vale-refeição;

Voucher para produtos da marca;

Coparticipação emacademia;

Plano de saúde com coparticipação de 30%.



Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho, baseado no respeito e na valorização das diferenças. Fique à vontade para declarar as informações do formulário de inscrição. Caso você não se sinta confortável em respondê-las é só optar por não responder. Essas informações nos ajudam a criar um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo e são utilizadas apenas para essa finalidade, são confidenciais e não impactarão no seu desempenho no processo seletivo.

Os dados que você informar no formulário do processo seletivo são confidenciais e estão armazenados em ambiente seguro, nós adotamos medidas técnicas e administrativas aptas para proteger os seus dados.

Formação superior em Física, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas (ou equivalente em experiência prática com forte capacidade analítica).

Experiência comprovada - 5 anos como cientista de dados

Conhecimento em processamento de dados geográficos e bibliotecas como Pandas, GeoPandas, Rasterio e NumPy.

Experiência ou interesse demonstrado na aplicação de métodos analíticos para resolver problemas reais, preferencialmente no setor agro ou áreas afins.

Experiência em machine learning aplicado a dados espaciais (ex: com Scikit-learn ou TensorFlow).

Conhecimento em cloud computing (GCP) para processamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Portfólio de projetos envolvendo análise espacial ou geoprocessamento.

title: Managing Director
description:
About Us

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.

We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.

We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services and as Contender in the Supply Chain IT Operation Services quadrant of the ISG Provider Lens™ Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories Logistics Consulting and TMS Provider .


Job descripiton:

The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Strategy

  • Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
  • Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
  • Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
  • Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.

Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects

  • Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
  • Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
  • Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
  • Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.


Qualifications and Competencies

Academic Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
  • Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.


Technical Skills (Supply Chain)

  • End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
  • Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.

title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and />
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.


Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills.

Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have good written and verbal communication skills in English and you can communicate with team members, clients, and stakeholders in English.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

title: Technical Lead – Divestitures
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Technical Lead – Divestitures who wants to learn and transform his career.


Job Description:

The Divestment Technical Lead, with a specialization in IT, will be responsible for leading and managing the IT aspects of divestitures and mergers and acquisitions (M&A). This role involves ensuring the integration or separation of IT in a smooth way, aligned with the organization's strategic objectives. This leader will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver effective solutions on time and on budget.


Main Responsibilities:

  • IT M&A Management: Conduct detailed assessments of target companies' IT infrastructure, systems, and applications to identify integration or separation needs. Create detailed technical plans for successful system integration or separation.
  • Leadership and Team Management: Overseeing cross-functional IT teams, ensuring effective collaboration and communication. Provide strategic guidance and leadership for the IT aspects of M&A activities.
  • Interdependency Management: Identify and manage interdependencies between IT and other business functions to ensure alignment and coordination.
  • Risks and Compliance: Identify and assess IT-related risks in M&A activities. Ensure that IT activities comply with data protection laws, industry regulations, and company policies.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 11 to 15 years of experience. At least 10 years in business leadership roles, with at least 5 years managing divestitures and mergers.
  • Education: Master's degree in Business Administration or related field. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field is required.
  • Technical Knowledge: Solid knowledge of IT infrastructure, systems and applications. Experience with IT risk management and compliance.


Soft Skills:

  • Leadership and Team Management Skills: Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and implement strategic plans that align with the organization's goals.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Adaptability: The ability to adapt to changing business environments and manage multiple priorities effectively.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • International Experience: Experience in international M&A projects.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent.
  • Knowledge: Familiarity with Gartner's IT M&A best practices. Experience with digital transformation projects.
  • Languages: Communication ability in English and/or French is considered an asset.

title: Project Integration Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Project Integration Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.


Job Description:

The Project Integration Specialist is responsible for overseeing the integration and coordination of various IT projects within the organization, ensuring that all components of the projects are aligned, executed efficiently, and meet the company's strategic objectives. This professional acts as a technical leader, advisor and mentor, ensuring the cohesion and success of integration projects.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Technical Consulting: Acting as a technical lead to ensure that project implementations are aligned with architectural design, guiding cross-functional teams, and fostering communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Solution Design: Develop and implement comprehensive integration plans for IT projects. Assess the compatibility and interoperability of different systems and technologies through thorough testing and evaluation.
  • Project and Resource Management: Plan and manage the timelines and deliverables of integration projects. Allocate and manage resources effectively, including budgeting and staffing. Monitor project progress and performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and budget.
  • Technology Selection and Validation: Conduct technical assessments and feasibility studies for new integration projects to determine the best approach and resources needed. Stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Risk Management: Identify and resolve integration issues and technical challenges through troubleshooting and collaboration with technical teams. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices throughout the integration process.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including integration plans, status reports, and risk assessments. Drive continuous improvement in integration processes and methodologies by analyzing project results and implementing feedback.


Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT project management, integration, or related field.
  • Systems Integration: Experience with a variety of integration tools and platforms (e.G., middleware, APIs) to facilitate the integration of projects, configuring and maintaining them. Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.G., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).
  • Architecture: Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and software development. Experience with software architecture design, including microservices, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), and cloud-based architectures.
  • Systems and Tools: Use of integration tools and platforms. Implementation and management of systems to track and report metrics of integration projects, including the configuration of dashboards and monitoring tools.


Soft Skills:

  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences (technical, executive, business). Build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure their needs are met and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to lead by example, working with cross-functional teams and building consensus among stakeholders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to think "in the big picture", aligning technological decisions with the company's long-term objectives.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and analytical profile, engaged in identifying and solving complex challenges.
  • Organization and Focus: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and results-focused environment.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or other relevant certifications. Certifications in cloud architecture (e.G., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Technologies: Experience with cloud computing and data integration. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Languages: English and/or French are considered an asset.


Expected Skills:

  • Ensure that the needs of the business are aligned with the architectural vision.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure scalability/performance, security, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in development processes and existing architecture.
  • Analyze the technological environment and seek possibilities for improvement and standardization in line with strategic planning.
  • Present to stakeholders how the architecture options will meet their needs.

title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Global Guest Experience Coordinator

Location: Remote – Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: Guest Experience


Reports To: Head of Global Guest Experience / Global Guest Experience Manager


About Us

QIG is a dynamic group comprising three companies:

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: A Copenhagen-based serviced apartment provider.

Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.

Although this position focuses on QGN, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.


Role Overv iew

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator acts as the vital link between our valued guests and our network of global suppliers. Your role is to ensure that guests enjoy an exceptional stay while suppliers are supported to deliver consistently high-quality service.

Based remotely in Brazil, you will support guest experiences and supplier relationships across colleagues and partners worldwide. This position requires strong relationship-building skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to anticipate needs on both sides of the partnership.


Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.


Complaint Resolution & Escalation Management:

  • Liaise daily with approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents across the globe to ensure smooth delivery of services.
  • Communicate guest feedback and issues to suppliers clearly, ensuring timely action.
  • Build and maintain strong, positive relationships with suppliers to foster trust and collaboration.
  • Monitor supplier performance and suggest improvements to strengthen our global network.


Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Balance guest needs with supplier capabilities to create win–win outcomes.
  • Anticipate challenges and take proactive steps to prevent service gaps.
  • Represent QIG as a supportive partner to both sides, ensuring everyone feels heard and valued.
  • Work closely with the reservations, supply, finance and sales teams across different regions to ensure smooth communication and coordination of guest requirements or special requests.


Feedback Collection & Reporting:

  • Encourage guests to complete feedback surveys and track satisfaction trends.

  • Contribute ideas and recommendations for improving the overall guest and supplier experience.

You won't just provide data;
you will provide the "so what" and "now what" that drives critical decisions.


If you're ready to own the strategic impact of analytics and influence at the CXO level, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do:

  • Drive Strategic Direction: Lead high-impact analytical workstreams across multiple products and business units, uncovering insights that shape our most important initiatives.
  • Influence Leadership: Synthesize complex data into clear, actionable strategic recommendations and present them compellingly to senior and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Mentor and Elevate: Guide and mentor junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical excellence, curiosity, and rigorous best practices across the team.
  • Champion Data-Driven Decisions: Partner directly with business leaders to identify opportunities, quantify risks, and establish metrics that define success.


Who You Are (Qualifications):

  • You have 6+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.G., Business Analyst, Data Science, Strategy) within a top-tier consulting firm, tech company, or product-led organization.
  • You possess expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, R, and data visualization tools (e.G., Tableau, Looker). Experience with AI/ML modeling is a significant plus.
  • You are a master of data storytelling —you can build a narrative, craft a compelling presentation, and confidently defend your recommendations to senior audiences.
  • You have proven leadership and mentoring capabilities , with a passion for elevating the skills of those around you.
  • You have an ownership mindset : you thrive in ambiguity, are relentlessly resourceful, and hold yourself accountable for driving tangible business outcomes.


Why Join Us?

  • Executive Impact: Your analysis will directly inform decisions at the highest levels of the company.
  • Leadership Opportunity: Step into a player-coach role where you can shape both strategy and team culture.
  • Complex Challenges: Tackle the most ambiguous and strategic business problems we face.


About Us-


Landmark Group


Our journey started in 1973 with a single store in Bahrain. Since then, we have grown into a global retail and hospitality group. The proud creator of 25 plus value led, own-built brands across retail, hospitality, food, and leisure.


Over the years, our UAE - based group has evolved into a comprehensive retail and hospitality entity, with over 2200 retail stores, leisure, and hospitality outlets, panning the GCC, Middle East, India, Southeast Asia, and Africa. Today, Landmark Group is one of GCC's largest omnichannel retailers and India's top home and fashion retailer.


We take immense pride in the organic growth of our retail brands, which have blossomed into household names. From Max, Splash, Babyshop, Centrepoint, Shoemart, Home Centre, Emax, Fitness First, to Fun City, to name a few, our brands span across a multitude of categories, enriching the lives of countless families over the past decade.


As a part of the Landmark Group, a renowned retail and hospitality conglomerate in the Middle East, North Africa, and India, Landmark Digital is the dynamic digital arm of Landmark Retail, serving as the cornerstone of our omnichannel business strategy.


Headquartered in Dubai, UAE, we oversee the digital operations of eight leading brands across diverse geographies, with ambitious plans for expansion into new territories and functions. Joining us means becoming a vital part of the Middle East's most significant bricks-to-clicks success story, boasting an impressive year-on-year growth rate exceeding 100%.


Comprising a talented workforce of over 700 professionals across diverse domains, Landmark Digital spearheads various functions including Enterprise and E-commerce Tech, Product Management, User Design, and MarTech, among others. With our futuristic outlook, we are committed to delivering seamless digital experiences to our customers.


Landmark Digital


At Landmark Digital, we cultivate an agile work culture , empowering you to make impactful decisions from day one within collaborative squads comprising professionals from over 20 nationalities. Additionally, our dedicated software development center in Bangalore, India, offers opportunities for incubation, design, and optimization of digital products.


Working at Landmark Digital means engaging with cutting-edge technologies , including Enterprise and E-commerce tech, headless commerce, Java Spring Boot, React Native, React frontend, and Azure Cloud solutions, providing an enriching environment for professional growth and development.


In addition to competitive remuneration and benefits , we prioritize continuous learning and growth through dedicated training and upskilling initiatives. Furthermore, our vibrant workplace culture fosters camaraderie through various team events, celebrations, and recreational amenities, ensuring a fulfilling experience both personally and professionally.


Come be a part of Landmark Digital, where innovation, collaboration, and growth converge to redefine the digital retail landscape

title: Analista De Merchandising Sênior
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO


Responsável por conduzir os processos da cadeia de compra das coleções e acompanhamento dos indicadores da área de produto, como OTB, compras, vendas, cash flow, margem, Sell Thru e loss end. Garantir a correta precificação e alocação de produtos na loja, bem como treinamento de equipe e analise de mercado. Ter contato direto com a loja e demais áreas que possuem interação para garantir o alinhamento 360° em relação a produto e a otimização da venda/giro.

Responsável pela movimentação de peças nos diferentes estoque (inclusive entre lojas da mesma marca), garantindo a acuracidade da oferta em cada canal.

Responsável pela interface com o Iguatemi365, no tange os KPIs da área: oferta, precificação, disponibilidade de produtos, giro, venda por produto.


OBSERVAÇÕES


  • Conhecimentos técnicos sólidos em Excel (ser avançado é mandatório);
  • Inglês avançado é mandatório;
  • Formação: Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Economia, e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos:
  • Conhecimentos de consumidor e tendências de comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos técnicos elementares em moda e mercado de luxo;


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?


  • Realizar a concepção do OTB (open to buy) diante da projeção e vendas determinada, considerando marca, coleções, categorias, subcategorias, itens, grade. Para acuracidade, deve considerar analise de histórico e tendências;
  • Realizar o processo de compra de produtos. Receber material da nova coleção, entender a inspiração junto a marca, analisar vendas e definir qual será o investimento de cada categoria (+subcategoria, itens, grade). Avaliar tendências e integrar equipe de varejo na definição dos produtos;
  • Realizar a precificação de produtos em linha com as premissas definidas e alinhadas com a marca e internamente determinadas pela iRetail. Sugerir as premissas adequadas para cada marca e momento, para tanto é necessário entender o mercado, analisar concorrência, para garantir que atingiremos os resultados definidos em budget;
  • Estar frequentemente em loja para acompanhar as vendas dos produtos junto à equipe de loja (in loco na loja), tanto quanti quanto qualitativamente, avaliar a exposição dos mesmos, reforçar o treinamento da equipe sobre a marca e os produtos. Propor sugestões de ações internas para melhoria do giro dos produtos (KPI);
    conectar frequentementecom Varejo e Marketing para discutir oportunidade e viabilidade das ações. Proatividade na busca de soluções para melhor girar produto;
  • Acompanhar o mercado de varejo, como ações e preços de concorrentes. Fazer uma análise crítica com relação ao que estamos praticando e, se necessário, propor mudanças;
  • Responsável pelo conhecimento das informações relacionadas a produto, assim como o treinamento da equipe. Garantir o conhecimento de todos os envolvidos no prazo necessário para que consigam agir em suas respectivas áreas;
  • Conhecer as clientes das marcas sob sua responsabilidade (grau de relacionamento de acordo com a tipo de cliente, as principais clientes precisa conhecer pessoalmente, ter relacionamento);
  • Garantir junto a área de Operações o recebimento dos produtos nos prazos necessários. Acompanhar todos os embarques e entender impactos de possíveis atrasos nos recebimentos e lidar com o Controle de Qualidade (processos, interface loja, com a marca e solicitar os devidos reembolsos);
  • Participar e contribuir em ações da marca (como eventos etc), garantindo excelência e ganho de conhecimento;
  • Garantir acuracidade nas informações quantitativas e qualitativas, na frequência demandada, dos relatórios e calls com as marcas, garantindo repasse de informação sobre nosso negocio;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente ágil e dinâmico com altas demandas;
  • Disponibilidadepara viajar internacionalmente para os markets das marcas - frequência de 1x por semestre.

title: Purchasing Analyst
description:
About us


OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

OPPO's footprint extends to more than 70 countries and regions, with over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers, where it employs more than 40,000 people dedicated to creating a better life for customers around the world through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talents to join us on this exciting journey!



Responsibilities


Supplier Management

  • Take on the procurement needs of materials (such as administrative supplies, warehousing logistics, service procurement, etc.), actively search for, evaluate, and screen potential suppliers and maintain a supplier database.

Procurement Execution

  • Develop detailed procurement plans based on the company's business needs, arrange the procurement schedule reasonably to ensure the timely, high-quality, and sufficient supply of materials, and avoid inventory overstock or stockouts.
  • Monitor the execution of procurement orders, communicate and coordinate with suppliers and relevant internal departments in a timely manner, resolve any abnormal situations that arise during the procurement process.
  • Be responsible for the acceptance of procurement materials, assist the demand personnel in verifying the quantity, specifications, quality, and other information of the goods to ensure that the warehoused materials meet the requirements, and handle the return and replacement procedures for non-conforming goods in a timely manner.

Cost Control

  • Keep track of the procurement cost levels of similar products in the industry through market research, inquiries, and price comparisons, and provide data support for the company's procurement decisions.

Information Management

  • Organize and file procurement contracts, invoices, acceptance documents, and other relevant procurement documents to ensure the completeness and accuracy of procurement records for easy reference and auditing.
  • Be proficient in using the procurement system to conduct work, update the data in the procurement system in a timely manner, including supplier information, procurement order status, inventory dynamics, etc., and provide accurate procurement data reports for the company to make scientific and rational decisions.

Other Work

  • Assist the superior in completing other tasks related to procurement.



Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree or above, major.
  • Advanced chinese and portuguese are mandatory.
  • It would be better if you could speak English too.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Be able to complete tasks on time and ensure work quality.
  • Be able to work under pressure.



Note: Please submit your CV in English.
